paths.name: #db-client
paths.message: #db-client is the raw D1 handle. Only the scoped-db factory, Better Auth, the pricing/cron jobs and the seed read it (allowlist: the db-access override at the bottom of this file + src/platform/server/db/db-access-allowlist.test.ts). Everything team-scoped goes through context.scopedDb.

paths.name: @/platform/server/db/scoped
paths.message: createScopedDb only in platform/middleware.fn.ts, billing/stripe-webhook-middleware.fn.ts and workflow/base-workflow.ts. Use context.scopedDb.

patterns.message: SQL lives in the db layer only: `src/**/server/db/**` (scoped-db modules), the schema, and the raw-db allowlist at the bottom of this file. Add a method there and call it through scopedDb — do not pass a Database handle into a domain module. `drizzle-orm/zod` (schema-derived validators) is fine anywhere.
src/**/server/** is server-only and must not ship to the browser. Import a domain-root helper, or make this a type-only import. Server fns (*.fn.ts) may import it inside .handler().
